verdict.rationale: Baseten's core hosted platform is proprietary SaaS with no evidence of open-sourced source code, but the companion Truss library (packaging/serving models) is publicly available on GitHub under an open-source repo, giving partial insight into some product-adjacent code. Missing for 10: no license/source access for the actual inference platform, dashboard, or MCM orchestration layer, and no confirmation Truss itself carries a recognized open license beyond being public on GitHub.
